subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Future of Compliance Culture
description: One-minute skill: The Future of Compliance Culture.

hook.text: AI can monitor every employee communication for misconduct. But should it? Ethics meets technology at the frontier.

buildup.text: RegTech uses AI to automate compliance monitoring, flag risks, and analyze patterns humans can't detect.

discovery.text: AI ethics tools can detect bias in hiring, lending, and insurance decisions before they cause harm.

twist.text: Surveillance-based compliance undermines trust. If employees feel watched, they comply out of fear, not conviction.

climax.text: The future of compliance culture balances technology's power with human judgment and respect for privacy.

punchline.text: AI monitors everything. Trust evaporates. Balance is key.

quiz.question: What is the main tension in AI-powered compliance?
options: Surveillance capabilities versus employee trust and privacy
AI is too expensive for most companies
AI cannot detect any compliance issues
